# vendored frontend libraries

Served locally from `/vendor/*` — no CDN, no network dependency. Versions are
pinned by these exact files; bump by replacing the file and updating this table
(and `ThirdPartyNotices.txt` at the repo root).

| file | library | version | upstream | license |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.umd.js` | marked | v18.0.11 | https://github.com/markedjs/marked | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify | 3.4.16 | https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify | Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0 |
| `uPlot.iife.min.js` + `uPlot.min.css` | uPlot | v1.6.32 | https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot | MIT |
